Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching the intersection when Driver 2, southbound, turned left
across the path of Driver 1's vehicle and struck the driver's side. The impact point on Driver 1's vehicle is consistent
with the damage pattern visible in the scene photographs, and the damage to both vehicles is largely in line with the
described impact. Driver 1 reported low back strain and was assessed at the scene; the nature and force of the
collision appear consistent with that complaint. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle,
and both officers and the Passenger confirmed that Driver 1 was occupying the vehicle at the time of the crash. No
independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of the drivers and the Passenger along
with the photographs taken at the scene, which confirm several of the reported details. Inspection found no prior
damage to Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 is not listed as a named driver on the policy and does not reside with the
policyholder, which has been noted for the file.
